config.paper: arXiv:2504.10783v1 Section VII-B, Appendix D Hardware, Table VI

assumptions.targets: Fixed FK targets selected before any roadmap or planning using the retained finite geometric scan. Virtual state advances only after strict candidate validation.
assumptions.cloud: Deterministic noiseless box surface samples; no camera ray tracing, occlusion, depth noise, calibration or device latency. Static table points are saved but excluded from online voxels as known background.
assumptions.mount: Public WSG frame adaptation and TCP offset are declared constructions, not author calibration.
assumptions.pairs: Record actual Drake/native candidates; do not add artificial pairs to match 105.
assumptions.budget: 240s trial/1800s offline watchdogs are construction limits, not paper parameters.
assumptions.limits: Published velocity/acceleration ±1; other spline/validation tolerances reused from declared v5 profile.

anchor_construction.criterion: First passing pair in preregistered finite geometric ordering; all 15 voxel and exact-solid layouts checked; no planning results used
